entries.zh: 语；话语；言语
entries.en: word; speech; language

entries.zh: 句；句子；计句之量词
entries.en: sentence, phrase; measure word (numeral) for utterances
entries.notes: 词头 numeral dellos~（dellos＝ellos 之缩写）展开依赖推断；M 栏兼含例词 labras。

entries.zh: 诀；一言定案、决断之语
entries.en: a man's definitive word; settled/final utterance

entries.zh: 开饭开场的用语（喽）；饭前头一句应酬话
entries.en: word said at the beginning of a meal; opening table phrase

entries.zh: 开饭开场的客套话（喽嗹哩）；并无深义，仅表寻常欢愉
entries.en: words said at the start of a meal; they mean nothing more than ordinary (common) cheer
entries.notes: san commun~ 缩写展开（疑为 sana común「寻常欢愉」）依赖推断。

entries.zh: 言语；话语（泛指说话）
entries.en: speech, words; language

entries.zh: 言谈；谈吐、交谈
entries.en: talk, conversation; discourse

entries.zh: 言词；词句、措辞
entries.en: words, wording; terms, expressions

entries.zh: 骂人；辱骂之重话
entries.en: harsh words; cursing, reviling people

entries.zh: 入骨话；刻毒刺骨之言（重话）
entries.en: biting words, remarks that cut to the bone ('greater words')

entries.zh: 恶语伤人；恶言重语害人
entries.en: evil words wound people; injurious speech

entries.zh: 蠢笨；言语蠢笨、笨拙之语
entries.en: foolish, clumsy words
entries.notes: M 音 pūn 与「笨」合而与「味」不合，疑「味」为「笨」之误识；义取词头「重话/蠢语」。

entries.zh: 求取（请求、索取）；与西语词头不合，释义存疑
entries.en: to seek and take, to request and obtain; does not match the transcribed Spanish headword
entries.notes: H/M 一致为「求取」，与 L『palabras pesadas』语义不合，本条实指无法定夺。

entries.zh: 二面；两面（疑为词条交叉注，指一词两面/两义）
entries.en: 'two faces' — two sides/senses; likely a cross-reference note
entries.notes: 西语『palabra que significa de ella』与「二面」对应不明，疑为对上词条之注记。

entries.zh: 比体（字义无法确解）；西语谓粗重之词，涉『贼』义
entries.en: (unclear) a heavy/coarse word apparently relating to 'thief'
entries.notes: L 中 foy~on、ladron~ 缩写展开不明，汉字「比體」与词头语义难以对应，疑原件误识。

entries.zh: 句句；每一句话、句句如此
entries.en: every word, each and every sentence; word for word

entries.zh: 永诀；临死永别之言
entries.en: words of farewell at death; final, eternal parting

entries.zh: 机密话；机密隐秘之言
entries.en: secret words; confidential talk

entries.zh: 话相合；言语相投、商定一致
entries.en: words in agreement; concerted, harmonized speech
entries.notes: M 栏尾音节 cūn 未明，或为补充音节；主义据 H「話相合」与词头 concertadas 相证。

entries.zh: 臭酸话；无礼冒犯之言（酸臭刻薄话）
entries.en: rude, discourteous words; sour, offensive talk

entries.zh: 话相拍；言语相冲突、话不投而争执
entries.en: words clashing; discordant speech, quarrel

entries.zh: 切言；恳切正直之言（正派人之言谈）
entries.en: earnest, honest words; straightforward speech of an honorable man
entries.notes: 「切言」非通行词，义据词头『palabras de hombre honrado』推断为恳切/正直之言。
